capabilities: Render AV signal-flow diagrams from text blocks
Generate cable, wireless, equipment and parts schedules from the same source
Flag connections whose signal types cannot physically work
Set light, dark, mono or blueprint themes per diagram or globally
disambiguation: Not a general diagramming tool; it renders only audio-visual signal-flow diagrams written in its own block language.
extras: Listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the full language specification lives in a separate repo (Love-Rox/kumihimo), and hand installation requires copying release files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no way to draw audio-visual system diagrams from text or to produce the schedules that must agree with them.

relations.evidence: The same compiler runs in a command-line tool, a VS Code extension and on the web

summary: Renders AV signal-flow diagrams from a text DSL in code blocks, with cable, wireless, equipment and parts schedules generated alongside.
